A true taste of Japan in Vietnam
Mar 2023 • Friends
After a week of consuming local Vietnamese cuisine, decided to go “foreign”.

One of the few outlets in a local chain, the food was excellent. The salmon sushi was my favourite. It was just simply delicious.

The salad that we wondered also went down a treat.

The timing of the arrival of the other menu items at our table was spot on. Empty dishes were cleared with a quiet efficiency.

If the crowd when we were there is anything to go by, I would suggest you make a reservation
